resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1931 newspaper report (quoted on Forest Lookouts) gives 50 feet; the 1952 Coast and Geodetic Survey description gives approximately 90 feet. The sources do not explain the difference, so the story gives both figures. The facts field keeps the 50-foot figure from the 1931 report.

sources.title: Lookouts of the Mena & Oden Ranger Districts, Arkansas

notes_for_editor: The 1931 height is a newspaper figure quoted second-hand on Forest Lookouts; the Hope Star original was not read. The removal date is not in any source read. The 'Today, only Rich Mountain, Bee Mountain and Tall Peak' passage on the ArkansasGenWeb page is ambiguous about scope, so the story only cites the Tall Peak line. Possible leads for a removal date: Mena/Oden Ranger District of the Ouachita National Forest records, or Polk County historical records. Present-day status and public access are unknown. The brief's access 'unknown' is kept, so no access fact is recorded.
